# Support Guidelines

Thank you for using CampusUNSA. This document provides official support channels and guidance for students, faculty, and engineering contributors.

---

## 1. Where to Get Help

Depending on the nature of your request, please use the appropriate channel:

### Academic & University Inquiries
- **Enrollment, Grades, and Official Procedures:** For questions regarding university administrative procedures, consult the secretarial guidance module within the CampusUNSA PWA or visit your faculty academic secretariat.
- **Institutional Email Issues:** If your `@unsa.edu.pe` institutional account cannot authenticate, contact the UNSA University Information Technology Directorate (DUTIC).

### Technical Assistance & Bug Reports
- **Bug Reports:** If you encounter unexpected system behavior, UI rendering errors, or broken synchronizations, open a formal issue using the [Bug Report Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/02_bug_report.yml).
- **Feature Requests:** Propose improvements or new capabilities using our [Feature Request / User Story Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/01_user_story_tdd.yml).
- **GitHub Discussions:** For general usage questions, peer discussions, and architecture inquiries, participate in the repository [Discussions](https://github.com/MarcoXMarquez/CampusUNSA/discussions).

### Security Vulnerabilities
- If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, do **NOT** post it publicly.
- Follow the instructions in our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) to report vulnerabilities privately.

---

## 2. Before Opening an Issue

To ensure efficient resolution, please verify the following:
1. Review the [README.md](README.md) and [System Architecture](docs/architecture/system-architecture.md) documentation.
2. Check existing open and closed [Issues](https://github.com/MarcoXMarquez/CampusUNSA/issues) to avoid duplicate submissions.
3. If reporting a defect, ensure you can provide step-by-step reproduction steps, environment details (browser, device, or OS), and terminal or console logs.

---

## 3. Communication Standards

All interactions across CampusUNSA support channels must adhere to our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Please maintain a constructive, respectful, and professional tone in all communications.
